dedupe_keys.name: a bidirectional swmm modflow 6 coupling for groundwater stormwater and sanitary sewer exchange under sea level rise

description: A bidirectional SWMM–MODFLOW 6 coupling for groundwater, stormwater, and sanitary-sewer exchange under sea-level rise is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Erukubami, Omowumi (deposited on HydroShare). A bidirectional coupling of EPA SWMM and MODFLOW 6 that exchanges fluxes at a daily stress period through MODFLOW API & PySWMM: subcatchment infiltration becomes groundwater recharge, groundwater drainage is injected into SWMM junctions, and head-based leakage into sanitary sewers is applied through the MODFLOW WEL package. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2026-07-31 and last updated 2026-08-10; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT License. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
